<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

2026-10-24: pij-cold-quelea sent a pointer to pij-public-anglerfish (Codex 0.164, pane %100). Receipt: `queued — unrecognized — cold-check: clear`; it never arrived. Cause: Codex 0.164's footer is `GPT-6.1-Sol high · ~/github/novels · Adopt seat and wait`. is_codex_footer (crates/harnesses/src/composer.rs:201) takes only the text after the LAST `·` and expects a path, so the footer is rejected, the composer is never recognised, and the pointer worker retries `unrecognized` forever. The same rsplit drives readiness and model/cwd extraction in adapter.rs, so the fix must be one segment parser for all of them.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- Deliveries to Codex 0.164 seats land.
- Older Codex footers keep working.
- Footer parsing has one definition.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- Codex's `$skill` invocation (a separate docs note).
- Other harnesses' recognisers.
- Changing the interaction gate or retry policy.
